description: The task actions as typed sub-blocks, each with its catch-all: create_task with a flow reference, a string map of attributes, a description and a static delay_seconds; with a task_template_id reference alone; with both references and a scheduled_time JSONPath; and with its contact_flow_id and delay_seconds JSONPaths, the flow and the tasktemplate bound in refs; and a paused task resumed (resume_contact {}). Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
